authOtherAccountBtn.description: Button on the auth page under a provider this device already signed in with. It reopens that provider's account picker instead of continuing as the account the browser holds. $PROVIDER$ is the provider's name (Google, Apple, ...).

authSignOutAtProviderBtn.description: Link on the auth page under a provider that cannot reopen its own account picker (Apple today). Apple ignores an OpenID `prompt`, so a browser already signed in there continues as that account without asking; this is the remedy for that case, not a step before every sign-in - a reader with no session at the provider is asked which account anyway. It opens the provider's account page, where ending the session lives. $PROVIDER$ is the provider's name.

deviceLimitHelpLink.description: Link shown beside both device-limit messages (the sign-in refusal and the Account-tab notice). It opens the help article that says what the monthly key limit is, what to do while it holds, and how to reach the operator. Deliberately short: it sits at the end of a sentence that already carries the news.
